resources.string: Check what this phone can use before starting a room scan.
Available by design. Measurements can still be entered manually when AR is unavailable.
Compatibility could not be confirmed yet
Supported and enabled for the diagnostic session
Not supported; AR measurement must work without Depth
Horizontal and vertical plane finding configured
Google Play Services for AR installation/update requested. The check will resume when you return.
Camera permission is required only for AR capture. Manual mode remains available.
This device cannot create an ARCore session.
Google Play Services for AR is not installed.
Google Play Services for AR must be updated.
The app ARCore SDK is too old for the installed service.
AR installation or update was declined.
Camera access is not available for AR.
This device rejected the requested AR session configuration.
AR session setup failed. Manual mode remains available.
Phase 0 diagnostic: this screen reports capability only. Measurement accuracy will be validated against a reference instrument on real devices.
Enter two measured sides of a rectangular room. Values are stored as meters in the geometry model.
This first fallback handles rectangular rooms. Free-form walls, openings and confidence tracking will build on the same geometry domain.
Depth assistance: unavailable; plane/feature hits are used
Starting the camera and AR session…
Move the phone slowly until tracking stabilizes and a surface is recognized.
Aim the center crosshair at the first point.
First point saved. Aim at the second point.
Measurement captured. Reset or capture again to start a new measurement.
No reliable surface at the crosshair. Move the phone and try again.
The AR session stopped. Return and use manual mode if the problem continues.
Phase 0: compare each AR measurement with the same dimension taken by a laser meter or tape. Results stay on this device until you export them.
Laser meter or tape, same endpoints as the AR measurement
Results with and without Depth are summarized separately
Trial saved. Kind, Depth and conditions were kept for the next one.
Enter an AR value greater than 0 and up to 100 m.
Enter a reference value greater than 0 and up to 100 m.
The trial list could not be updated on this device. Try again; if it keeps failing, export the CSV so the data is not lost.
No trials yet. Measure a span with AR, measure the same span with a laser meter or tape, and enter both above. Record several per type before drawing conclusions.
The comparison will be removed from this device. Exported files are not affected.
These numbers describe this device under the recorded conditions only. They are not a certified accuracy and must not be generalized to other phones.
